subject: D-06 C-CODE-07 consume and MIG APP_W
body:
TASK: D-06 C-CODE-07 consume + MIG APP_W
STATUS: CANDIDATE. Not MIG_PASS. Not FEM_PERSIST_PASS. PROGRAM=NO.

SPEAR/Q*: live package now has C-CODE-07 spear_rank + qstar_select.

K_HARD is runtime_profile; K_HARD_MAX is SPEAR slot ceiling (default 8). k_hard>K_HARD_MAX -> k_invalid=1 fail-closed, no silent clamp.

FEM: D did NOT take recover_state[2:0]=3 as a fourth compaction state (A-C-14). dest_committed_corrupt remains FEM_DEST_INTEGRITY. Please wait on t2_ack.

MIG: generated native UI under D:/FPGA/miggen (package path hit Windows 260). APP_DATA_WIDTH=128 FACT from mig0_mig.v (2*4*16). ECC=OFF. ADDR_WIDTH=28. Not MIG_PASS (no calib/readback).
M3: M3_WALK_XSIM_PASS hop1 CANDIDATE, not M3_PASS.
